title: A factor hides in the exponent
hook: A factor hides in the exponent. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Use smoothness of p-1 to find a factor with gcd(a^M-1,n).

misconception: A large exponent modulo a composite only helps primality testing.
objective: Use smoothness of p-1 to find a factor with gcd(a^M-1,n).

claims.text: A smooth factor-minus-one can make the modular power equal one modulo that factor. But an exponent covering both factors can give the entire number as gcd; the contrast demonstrates why this is not a useful factor.
